title: Spectrum TG56PD Self-Propelled Petrol Lawn Mower (56cm)
description_html:
Spectrum TG56PD 56cm Petrol Lawnmower

The Spectrum TG56PD is a powerful and practical petrol lawnmower designed to make maintaining medium and large gardens quicker and easier. With its generous 56cm cutting width, it covers a wide area with every pass, helping reduce the time and effort needed to mow larger lawns.

At the heart of the mower is a strong 196cc four-stroke petrol engine, providing dependable cutting performance even when working through longer or thicker grass. As a petrol-powered machine, it gives you the freedom to work around the garden without being restricted by electrical cables or battery run times.

The TG56PD features eight adjustable cutting heights, allowing you to choose the finish that best suits your lawn. Whether you prefer a closely cut, tidy appearance or want to leave the grass slightly longer during warmer or drier weather, the cutting height can be adjusted to suit the conditions.

For added versatility, the mower offers both collection and mulching functions. Use the large 60-litre grass box when you want a clean, freshly cut finish with the clippings removed. Its generous capacity means fewer stops to empty it, while the built-in grass-box-full indicator lets you know when it is time to do so.

Alternatively, the mulching function finely cuts the grass clippings and returns them to the lawn. This can help save time by removing the need to empty the grass box, while the fine clippings naturally break down into the soil.

Weighing 38kg, the Spectrum TG56PD has a robust and substantial construction suited to regular use across larger lawn areas. Its combination of a wide cutting deck, powerful engine, adjustable cutting heights and flexible mowing options makes it an excellent all-round choice for homeowners who need an efficient mower for a medium or large garden.

Key Features

  • Powerful 196cc four-stroke petrol engine
  • Wide 56cm cutting width
  • Eight adjustable cutting heights
  • Mulching and grass collection
  • Large 60-litre grass box
  • Convenient grass-box-full indicator
  • Ideal for medium and large gardens
